reason: I already check the placement cell and the usual job platforms, so I do not see enough reason to set up another tool myself. Free software still means I would have to arrange hosting and provider keys, which feels like extra work during placement season.
objection: Will this save me enough time compared with the sources I already use to justify setting it up?
would_change_my_mind: A ready-to-use mobile demo that shows current India roles with clear eligibility and original links.
